neighbours.label: blocking or discouraging an action (deter/stop/prevent/keep X from doing, anti-competitive), as opposed to the same actors and actions without the blocking
fire: Tall fences are meant to deter deer from entering the garden.

The court blocked the company from selling the land.
Vaccines prevent the virus from spreading through schools.
Regulators want to curb anticompetitive mergers in the tech sector.
Cameras at the junction deter motorists from running red lights.
